about: New papers from the research radar, placed approximately in the galaxy: each sits at the similarity-weighted centre of the items it is most like (full-text key terms), not where a rebuild of the full-text map would put it.

fields.stars: id (DOI), x y z (galaxy-data.json units), g (topic group), month, year, author, title, near (indices of the library items it was placed among, or for a paper already in the library its nearest items in the map), fit (exact: already in the library, at its own place | close | loose: placed approximately), href (its entry on the page)
